register_address_scheme: Every EtherCAT Slave Controller (ESC) exposes a single, flat 64-KByte memory map at offsets 0x0000-0xFFFF. The map is divided into a hardware-fixed Register Region at 0x0000-0x0FFF and a configurable DPRAM Region at 0x1000-0xFFFF used for Process-Data SyncManager buffers and mailbox SyncManager buffers. Access from the wire uses Cmd-dependent addressing (AP/FP/BC/LOG); access from the local µC uses the PDI (byte-level R/W on the same 64-KByte space). The register map below is a stable subset documented across all major ESC implementations (Beckhoff ET1100/ET1200/ET1815, Microchip LAN9252, Renesas RZ/N, etc.).

esc_register_region_summary.name: ESC Information
esc_register_region_summary.purpose: Type, Revision, Build, Number of FMMUs, Number of SMs, RAM size, Port descriptor, ESC features.

esc_register_region_summary.name: Station Address
esc_register_region_summary.purpose: Configured Station Address (0x0010-0x0011) + Configured Station Alias (0x0012-0x0013) used as the FP-addressing target.

esc_register_region_summary.name: Write Protection
esc_register_region_summary.purpose: Register Write Enable / Protection for security.

esc_register_region_summary.name: ESC Reset
esc_register_region_summary.purpose: ESC reset request from PDI and ECAT bus.

esc_register_region_summary.name: ESC DL Control
esc_register_region_summary.purpose: Forwarding mode, Loop Control per port, RX FIFO Size, Station Alias enable.

esc_register_region_summary.name: ESC DL Status
esc_register_region_summary.purpose: Per-port link state, loop state, signal-detect; PDI operational.

esc_register_region_summary.name: Application Layer Control + Status
esc_register_region_summary.purpose: AL Control (0x0120) — MainDevice writes to request ESM state. AL Status (0x0130) — SubDevice writes to confirm. AL Status Code (0x0134) — error number.

esc_register_region_summary.name: PDI Control
esc_register_region_summary.purpose: PDI type selector (asynchronous µC bus / synchronous µC bus / SPI / DIO / on-chip CPU).

esc_register_region_summary.name: PDI Configuration
esc_register_region_summary.purpose: PDI-specific configuration registers (SPI mode, data hold time, etc.).

esc_register_region_summary.name: Interrupt Mask + Request
esc_register_region_summary.purpose: ECAT Event Mask, PDI Interrupt Configuration, IRQ output enable.

esc_register_region_summary.name: Interrupt Status
esc_register_region_summary.purpose: Per-event interrupt status latching.

esc_register_region_summary.name: RX Error Counters
esc_register_region_summary.purpose: Per-port Frame-Error / Physical-RX-Error / Forwarded-RX-Error / Lost-Link counters.

esc_register_region_summary.name: Lost Link Counters
esc_register_region_summary.purpose: Per-port lost-link event counter.

esc_register_region_summary.name: Watchdog Divider
esc_register_region_summary.purpose: Watchdog time base (100 MHz / divider).

esc_register_region_summary.name: Process-Data WD + PDI WD
esc_register_region_summary.purpose: Process-data watchdog timeout, PDI watchdog timeout, watchdog status.

esc_register_region_summary.name: EEPROM Interface (SII)
esc_register_region_summary.purpose: EEPROM Configuration (0x0500), EEPROM PDI Access (0x0501), EEPROM Control/Status (0x0502), EEPROM Address (0x0504), EEPROM Data (0x0508).

esc_register_region_summary.name: MII Management Interface
esc_register_region_summary.purpose: MII PHY register access — MII Control/Status (0x0510), PHY Address (0x0512), PHY Register Address (0x0513), PHY Data (0x0514-0x0515), MII ECAT-Access (0x0516).

esc_register_region_summary.name: FMMU (8 entries × 16 bytes)
esc_register_region_summary.purpose: Per-FMMU: Logical Start Address (4B), Length (2B), Logical Start Bit (3b), Logical Stop Bit (3b), Physical Start Address (2B), Physical Start Bit (3b), Type (R/W), Active. See fmmu_entry_layout.

esc_register_region_summary.name: SyncManager (8 entries × 8 bytes)
esc_register_region_summary.purpose: Per-SM: Physical Start Address (2B), Length (2B), Control (1B: Buffered/Mailbox mode, Direction, ECAT-Event Enable, PDI-Event Enable, Watchdog Trigger), Status (1B: Buffer State / Mailbox State, Interrupt-Read / Interrupt-Write), Activate (1B), PDI Control (1B). See sm_entry_layout.

esc_register_region_summary.name: Distributed Clocks
esc_register_region_summary.purpose: Receive Time Port 0/1/2/3 (0x0900-0x090F), System Time (0x0910-0x0917), Receive Time PDI Buffer (0x0918), System Time Offset (0x0920), System Time Delay (0x0928), Speed Counter Start / Diff (0x0930), Filter Depth (0x0934), Cyclic Unit Control (0x0980), Activation (0x0981), SYNC0/SYNC1 Cycle/Pulse Length / Start Time (0x0982-0x09A8).

esc_register_region_summary.name: ESC Specific Registers
esc_register_region_summary.purpose: ESC-vendor-specific control.

esc_register_region_summary.name: Power-On Values
esc_register_region_summary.purpose: Implementation-defined.

esc_register_region_summary.name: DPRAM (Process Data + Mailbox)
esc_register_region_summary.purpose: Configurable user space. Typical layout: SM0 = 0x1000 MBox-Out (e.g. 256B), SM1 = 0x1400 MBox-In (256B), SM2 = 0x1800 Outputs (variable), SM3 = 0x1C00 Inputs (variable).

esc_information_registers.name: RAM Size
esc_information_registers.description: RAM size in KByte (typically 8 KByte for ET1100; 60 KByte for larger ESCs).

esc_information_registers.name: Port Descriptor
esc_information_registers.description: Per-port descriptor: not-implemented / MII / EBUS — 2 bits per port × 4 ports.

esc_information_registers.name: ESC Features Supported
esc_information_registers.description: Bit-mask of supported features: FMMU-bit-operation, DC, DC-64bit, low-jitter EBUS, extended ALsync, etc.

station_address_registers.name: Configured Station Address
station_address_registers.description: Used as the FP-addressing target. Written by the MainDevice during start-up.

station_address_registers.name: Configured Station Alias
station_address_registers.description: Persistent secondary address loaded from SII EEPROM if alias-enable bit is set in DL Control.

al_control_status_registers.name: AL Control

field_layout.name: Acknowledge
field_layout.values: 1 = MainDevice acknowledges the SubDevice's AL Status Code.

field_layout.name: Device Identification Request
field_layout.values: 1 = MainDevice requests Device Identification (used in Hot Connect).

al_control_status_registers.description: MainDevice writes this register (via FPWR) to request the next ESM state.

al_control_status_registers.name: AL Status

field_layout.name: Error Ind.
field_layout.values: 1 = SubDevice could not satisfy the requested transition; check AL Status Code.

field_layout.name: Device Identification Valid
field_layout.values: 1 = Device Identification Value (0x0134-0x0135 alt usage in Hot Connect) is valid.

al_control_status_registers.description: SubDevice reflects the current ESM state and Error indication; the MainDevice reads via FPRD to confirm.

al_control_status_registers.name: AL Status Code
al_control_status_registers.description: IEC 61158-defined error code (e.g. 0x0011 'Invalid requested state change', 0x001E 'Invalid Input Configuration', 0x0030 'Watchdog reset', 0x0046 'Sync2Watchdog').

fields.name: Logical Start Address
fields.description: Start of the mapped region in the network-wide 32-bit Logical Address space.

fields.name: Length
fields.description: Length of the mapped region in bytes (≥1).

fields.name: Logical Start Bit
fields.description: Start bit offset inside Logical Start Address byte (0..7).

fields.name: Logical Stop Bit
fields.description: Stop bit offset (inclusive) inside the last byte of the mapped region.

fields.name: Physical Start Address
fields.description: Start of the mapped region in local ESC memory (0x1000-0xFFFF typical).

fields.name: Physical Start Bit
fields.description: Start bit offset in physical memory (0..7).

fields.name: Type — Read
fields.description: 1 = This FMMU services LRD / LRW for the mapped logical region.

fields.name: Type — Write
fields.description: 1 = This FMMU services LWR / LRW for the mapped logical region.

fields.name: Physical Start Address
fields.description: Buffer start address in local ESC memory.

field_layout.name: Direction
field_layout.values: 0=Read (PDI reads, MainDevice writes — Outputs), 1=Write (PDI writes, MainDevice reads — Inputs)

field_layout.name: ECAT Event Enable
field_layout.values: 1 = Generate interrupt to MainDevice on access

field_layout.name: PDI Event Enable
field_layout.values: 1 = Generate interrupt to PDI on access

field_layout.name: Watchdog Enable
field_layout.values: 1 = This SM triggers the Process-Data Watchdog

fields.name: Status
fields.description: Buffer status: Buffer 0/1/2 last written, mailbox buffer full/empty, ECAT-Read-Int-Pending, PDI-Read-Int-Pending.

fields.name: PDI Control
fields.description: PDI deactivate of buffer / re-arm of mailbox.

distributed_clocks_registers.name: Receive Time Port 0
distributed_clocks_registers.description: Local time at which the first SOF after activation was received on Port 0.

distributed_clocks_registers.name: System Time
distributed_clocks_registers.description: Common nanosecond-class System Time; written by ARMW from the reference SubDevice.

distributed_clocks_registers.name: Receive Time PDI
distributed_clocks_registers.description: System Time at the moment the current frame entered the ESC's PDI.

distributed_clocks_registers.name: System Time Offset
distributed_clocks_registers.description: Offset between local time and System Time.

distributed_clocks_registers.name: System Time Delay
distributed_clocks_registers.description: Per-SubDevice propagation delay from the reference SubDevice.

distributed_clocks_registers.name: System Time Diff
distributed_clocks_registers.description: Difference between System Time and local time (drift measure).

distributed_clocks_registers.name: Sync0 Cycle Time
distributed_clocks_registers.description: Period between SYNC0 pulses in nanoseconds.

distributed_clocks_registers.name: Sync1 Cycle Time
distributed_clocks_registers.description: Period between SYNC1 pulses in nanoseconds.

distributed_clocks_registers.name: Sync Start Time
distributed_clocks_registers.description: System Time at which the first SYNC0 pulse shall be generated.

eeprom_sii_registers.name: EEPROM Configuration
eeprom_sii_registers.description: Bit 0 = EEPROM PDI Access; bit 8 = EEPROM emulation.

eeprom_sii_registers.name: EEPROM Address
eeprom_sii_registers.description: Word address into the SII EEPROM.

rx_error_counter_registers_per_port.name: Frame Error Counter Port 0
rx_error_counter_registers_per_port.description: Increment on receive frame error (FCS, length, etc.).

rx_error_counter_registers_per_port.name: Physical RX Error Port 0
rx_error_counter_registers_per_port.description: Increment on PHY-level errors (symbol error, signal-lost).

rx_error_counter_registers_per_port.name: Forwarded RX Error Port 0
rx_error_counter_registers_per_port.description: Forwarded RX errors (errors carried in from upstream).

rx_error_counter_registers_per_port.comment: Ports 1-3 use the same layout offset by +1 / +2 / +3 within each byte group.

mii_management_registers.name: MII Control/Status
mii_management_registers.description: MII command (read=0x00, write=0x01), interface state, error flags.

mii_management_registers.name: MII ECAT-Access Enable
mii_management_registers.description: Bit 0 = ECAT bus is master of MII; bit 1 = PDI is master.
